menu-order.hint: Food orders always use menu-order (pizza, burgers, takeaway), never a form.

booking.hint: Write services and days only when it is not a table (a dentist, a haircut), slot start like "2026-10-14T09:00".

map.line: center [lat,lng], zoom, markers[{id,lat,lng,label}], paths[{id,points:[[lat,lng]...]}]; tiles "osm"; say routes are approximate.

growth-projection.hint: It has its own deposit, rate and years controls; never add inputs around it.

invoice-layout.hint: An invoice or quote is an invoice-layout (from, billTo, invoiceNumber, issueDate, lines [{description, quantity, unitPrice}], total), never a table of inputs; summary rows use value.

checklist-layout.hint: Use for any list of items with statuses and progress, never a select per row: items [{id, label, state: pending|in-progress|done|blocked|skipped, due?}], showProgress true.

exec-dashboard.hint: A financial summary, KPIs or revenue is an exec-dashboard of raw rows and measures, never hand-built stat tiles.

form-layout.hint: A survey, feedback form or questionnaire is a form-layout with sections [{id, title}] and a form inside holding the questions.

stat.hint: Round numbers before writing them (whole numbers for counts, 1 decimal for hours): an average of fixed data is its rounded number, never a division.

table.hint: Keep cells to short phrases; put explanations in a callout or text below.

weather-forecast.line: {place, unit?: C|F, now?: {temp, condition, feelsLike?, humidity?, wind?}, days: [{day, condition, high, low, rainChance?, sunrise?, sunset?}] (1 to 14, first is today), hourly?: [{time, temp, condition, rainChance?}] (up to 48), note?}: a weather forecast. condition is sunny|partly-cloudy|cloudy|rain|heavy-rain|thunder|snow|fog|wind|night-clear. Unless a tool gave the numbers, note "Sample forecast".

week-schedule.hint: events start and end "HH:MM", color one per kind of event; bind a state key.

agenda.hint: start "HH:MM", minutes per item; bind a state key.

place-results.hint: places rows also take reviews?, price? (1 to 4), distance? ("350 m"), walkMinutes?, open?, hours?, tags?, blurb?, lat?, lng? (lat/lng add a map). Generic sample names unless a tool found real places. on_choose may emit ask {text}.

product-grid.hint: products rows also take color? (blue|violet|teal|green|amber|rose|orange|slate) and up to 3 short specs, never an image. Generic names, never a real brand with a price. on_choose may emit ask {text}.

media-grid.hint: items rows also take blurb? and color? (blue|violet|teal|green|amber|rose|orange|slate), never an image; bind a state key. on_choose may emit ask {text}.
